name: class-advancement-paid-prerequisites-4924
contract: Issue #4924 describes removing a talent-tree prerequisite while retaining dependent talents. This case
covers the explicit paid dependency in the original CharacterAdvancement data: Crusader Righteous Tempest
entry 34372 (805409) requires Scourgebane entry 4024 and Divine Force entry 31314 (806153). The archived
Exiles page independently lists Requires Scourgebane -> Divine Force, SHA256
Use native complete-build uploads to buy both, reject parent-only removal without billing or mutation,
allow child-then-parent removal, reject a child purchase with the parent missing, and restore both.
Keep the effective loader rule that grants ordinary identity passives at level ten without their old
class-entry prerequisite. This case does not infer additional dependencies from client visual tree arrows.

steps.label: Purchase the explicit paid class prerequisite normally
Purchase Righteous Tempest with Divine Force present
Removing the prerequisite while retaining its paid child is refused atomically
The refused upload preserves the dependent ability
Refusing an invalid tree does not bill the removal
A normal paid child removal remains allowed
The parent can be removed after the dependent is removed
Crusader identity preserves its effective automatic level-ten grant
A paid child cannot be purchased without its explicit prerequisite
Repurchasing the prerequisite restores a valid native purchase path
